text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sarajevo press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- First session of the new three-man Bosnian Presidency is expected to be held in Sarajevo next Monday, sources close to newspaper say.
- Bosnian currency will be convertible in the next six years and will have a fixed foreign exchange rate, the Governor of the Bosnian National Bank says.

- I think we are close to reaching an agreement to exchange 37 prisoners held by Republika Srpska for some 20 Serbs held by the Federation, the head of Bosnian Serb exchange commission Dragan Bulajic says.
